'''''The Clone Wars''''' was one of the two most popular segments of the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] life story. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] bought a [[display disk]] for his father, [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] head [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], as a souvenir during his [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />
